units.source_scale_reason: Reviewed source-resolution registration; one anatomical scale per original image.

visual_review.notes: Reviewed every take by contact strip. Walk and cast were retaken with steady light because the first takes darkened the plate on each stride or during the sweep back; the walk loops video 30-90 every second frame and the cast crosses the daggers and returns. Hit uses the flinch and recovery before its dark plates; defend ends on the crossed-blade guard before its dark plates. Idle, attack and death are the first takes.
